contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Oxygeneo Facials in Ghaziabad & Noida

Oxygenate, Rejuvenate And Reveal Radiant Skin

Overview

OxyGeneo Facial is an advanced skin rejuvenation treatment designed to exfoliate, oxygenate, and nourish the skin simultaneously.

The treatment works by stimulating natural oxygenation from within the skin while delivering beneficial active ingredients to improve hydration, texture, and overall radiance. Suitable for a variety of skin types, OxyGeneo Facial helps address concerns such as dullness, uneven tone, dehydration, and early signs of ageing. The result is smoother, brighter, and healthier-looking skin with minimal downtime and immediate visible freshness.

Key benefits

  • Enhances natural skin oxygenation
  • Improves hydration and skin freshness
  • Promotes a brighter, radiant complexion
  • Helps refine skin texture and tone
  • Supports healthy skin rejuvenation
  • Suitable for most skin types
  • Minimal downtime with immediate glow

Who should opt

  • Individuals with dull or tired skin
  • People seeking a healthy skin glow
  • Those with dehydrated skin concerns
  • Individuals preparing for special occasions
  • People wanting regular skin maintenance
  • Anyone looking for non-invasive rejuvenation

The Procedure

01

Detailed skin assessment and consultation

02

Deep cleansing and gentle exfoliation

03

Application of customised active ingredients

04

Hydration and skin rejuvenation treatment

05

Sun protection and post-care guidance
